summary: Explains module_defaults at play, block or task level to set default arguments for a module; explicit task args override, an empty dict clears defaults, and play-level defaults also affect roles.
questions: How do I set default arguments for a module across a play?
How do I clear module_defaults for one task?

answer_card.title: Setting module_defaults
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: localhost
  module_defaults:
    ansible.builtin.file:
      owner: root
      group: root
      mode: 0755
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.file:
        state: touch
        path: /tmp/file1
```

Works at play, block and task level; explicit task arguments win. Clear with an empty dict (`module_defaults: {file: {}}`). Play-level defaults (and those on `include_role`/`import_role`) also apply inside roles, which can surprise you.
